in_marathi.name: Nagarajan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagarajan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nagarajan is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'King of Serpents'. This powerful and majestic name is believed to bring protection, courage, and wisdom. It is also associated with the Hindu deity Nagaraja, who is the king of all serpents and the lord of the underworld.
